head:
TO THE RIGHT
HONORABLE VI-
COVNT WALLINGFORD,
Lord Knollys, Baron of Greys,
Master of the Wards and Liveries,
Knight of the noble Order of the Garter,
and one of His Maiesties most
Honorable Priuie Councell, Grace,
Mercy, and Peace, here, and
euerlasting.
tail:
